label: PF Backlog 545
title: C13: Per-generated-product Security Profile/Manifest derived from product capabilities
body:
## Problem / why
Security requirements are not auto-derived per generated product.
## Acceptance criteria
PF inspects whether a product uses LLM/RAG/agents/tools/external APIs/sensitive data/code-exec/browser/memory/delegation/autonomous actions and emits a security_profile manifest (guardrails, rag, tool_gateway, sandbox, network, secrets, approval, audit, kill_switch) + a gate.
